title: application
description: A grant application submitted within a given ApplicationWindow. An application is not an award, recommendation, project, or proof of payment. Missing applicant identity or project geometry must resolve to an explicit unresolved state.

window_ref.description: Reference to the ApplicationWindow under which this application was submitted.

applicant_ref.description: Reference to the applicant organization identity, or null if not yet resolved.

applicant_resolution_status.description: Resolution status of the applicant identity. Missing applicant identity must be stored as unresolved, not guessed.

requested_amount.description: Amount requested as stated by the source. Null if not publicly disclosed. Distinct from recommended_amount and awarded_amount.

project_location_ref.description: Reference to the project location geometry record, or null.

geometry_confidence.description: Confidence in the project geometry resolution. Missing or unverified geometry must be stored as unresolved.
